snippet.title: Idle Iktah - Trailer!
snippet.description:
Idle Iktah is an incremental game where you start from nothing and create your own path to success. Level up, complete quests, and gain powerful rewards as you dive deeper into this hand-crafted adventure!

Join the fun!
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/idle-iktah/id1631764038
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.grounded.idleiktah
